analysis.reasonEn: RSI remains stuck in the neutral zone at 45.8. MACD histogram is also worsening from -0.1146 to -0.2073, indicating downward pressure. A Lower High pattern is forming as the 5-day high is below the 20-day high, increasing the possibility of a bearish reversal. While the 52-week position at 34.9% suggests some downside support, the absence of clear bullish signals warrants a wait-and-see approach.
